config_verbatim:
# The PRIME re-baseline on nomic-embed-text.
#
# Exists because the embedder changed and every existing PRIME arm is
# Nemotron-3-Embed-1B. Comparing a nomic MAG run against a Nemotron PRIME run
# would confound the corpus (what we want to measure) with the model (what we
# changed), so PRIME is re-run here on nomic and MAG runs on nomic too.
#
# ## Why the model changed
#
# Nemotron-3-Embed-1B did not earn its size. Against the precomputed ada-002
# control on the same split, at 2048 dimensions against 1536:
#
#     vss-control.dense      mrr=0.2306  recall@20=0.3788   (ada-002)
#     native-wholedoc.dense  mrr=0.2163  recall@20=0.3778   (Nemotron)
#
# Worse MRR, a tie on recall, and 3.4x slower to embed: 18 texts/s against
# nomic's measured 61 texts/s on 5,000-character inputs. That throughput gap
# is what made MAG a 10.8-hour ingest instead of a 3.2-hour one, and it was
# misread three times today as a broken endpoint before it was measured.
#
# ## This is NOT a clean single-variable swap, and it cannot be made one
#
# The chunker differs too, and it has to. nomic's hard ceiling is 2048
# tokens against Nemotron's 4096, so `capped-whole-5000` overruns it -- the
# server rejects a 2083-token chunk outright. This arm therefore runs
# `capped-whole-2400`. RESULTS.md finding 4 measures a 25% spread in dense
# mrr across chunkers, so changing the cap moves a variable that matters --
# in an unknown direction, since finding 3 retracted the claim that finer is
# monotonically worse.
#
# So `native-wholedoc` minus `nomic-wholedoc` is the model AND the
# granularity its context limit forces, and a gap cannot be attributed to
# either alone. Read it as "nomic as it can actually be run here against
# Nemotron as it can actually be run here", which is a fair operational
# comparison and not a clean scientific one.
#
# Making it clean would mean re-running Nemotron at a 4000-character cap.
# That is a real option and it is not taken here only because Nemotron
# embeds at 18 texts/s against nomic's 60 -- see BACKLOG B-NOMIC-CONFOUND-1.
name: nomic-wholedoc
dataset: prime
split: test-0.1
chunker: capped-whole-2400
embeddings: nomic-embed-text
dimension: 768
aggregation: max
agent: dense
k: 20

# nomic-embed-text is asymmetric and its prefixes are NOT the `passage: ` /
# `query: ` pair the Nemotron configs use -- they are these, and getting them
# wrong is silent. `results/archive/nomic-no-prefixes` is what omitting them
# looked like: well-formed vectors, plausible scores, quietly worse than the
# model can do.
document_prefix: "search_document: "
query_prefix: "search_query: "
